title: Pdusen's Knowledge Packs
tagline: Adds knowledge packs specific to The Great Cities of JK's North (Winterhold) and Ultimate College of Winterhold
description:
A small collection of Knowledge Packs for the SkyrimNet. Each pack teaches SkyrimNet's NPCs about locations and characters added by specific mods, so those NPCs can talk about their surroundings and neighbors as though they actually live there. Import the `.sknpack` files via SkyrimNet's Web GUI.

**Included Packs:**

- **The Great Cities of JK's North - Winterhold** — covers the rebuilt Winterhold produced by combining
 JK's Skyrim, Great City of Winterhold v4, and Cities of the North - Winterhold via **The Great Cities of
 JK's North - Patch**.
- **Ultimate College of Winterhold + Immersive College NPCs** — covers the expanded College produced by
 combining Immersive College of Winterhold, Obscure's College of Winterhold, and Immersive College NPCs
 via **Ultimate College of Winterhold - an ICOW and OCW Patch**.
author: pdusen
